name: Troll Temper
label: Quest
description: Troll Temper: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can! It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well.
Zul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan. Good luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me the temper, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this is very nice temper indeed! And so much of it! I'll be at work for days before I use it all!
Thank you, friend. Please, take this as payment.
